title: ERP Domain Event Envelope
description: Standard envelope for all ERP domain events published to Kafka

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event instance

aggregate_type.description: The aggregate root type, e.g. JournalEntry

aggregate_id.description: ID of the aggregate that produced this event

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for tracing across services

causation_id.description: ID of the command/event that caused this event

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event occurred

version.description: Schema version for this event type
